task_message:
Case V39: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 161x161x126 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case V39 is complete.

**Summary:**
- **Target:** Large vascular soft-tissue tumor (T2-hyperintense, lobulated mass with bright core and heterogeneous periphery) in the limb, spanning axial slices 0–66, ~88 mm AP and ~66 mm LR.
- **Final mask (v3):** 149.3 mL, single connected component, produced from 3 positive points on the largest tumor section, refined with additional periphery points and one model refinement pass.
- **Verification:** Five-slice final review in all three planes confirmed the green outline tracks the tumor boundary; past-the-mask panels contained only normal muscle/fat or isolated vessels. All automatic candidates (C1–C5) were rejected as skin/subcutaneous rim or contralateral-limb vessels.
- **Confidence:** medium — boundary clearly follows the mass in all planes; the only judgment call was exclusion of diffuse perilesional hyperintensity (edema-like signal) around the tumor.
